claims.statement: For every nonempty ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star profile, every original deletion polynomial Av (A0 for deletion of vertex 2 or Ai for deletion of a private tip in branch i), and every natural k with 1<=k and 2k<=N+2, integer-zero-extended coefficients satisfy Av[k+1] C[k-1] <= Av[k] C[k], where C=G product_i B_(r_i).
claims.scope: Guarded lower-half shifted-C comparison for all profiles and original deletion types, with no actual eligibility premise. Retains the exact rank guards and definitions L=1+z, G=1+2z, B_r=L^r+z, N=sum_i r_i. No payment or aggregate follows from the bounded checks.
claims.reason: Independent exact replay found no failure through 18 branches and literal tree-DP matched the coefficient formulas for profile (2,3,4), but neither supplies a universal proof or guarded counterexample. The known rank-77 negative margin lies outside 2k<=N+2.

claims.statement: For every nonempty ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star profile, let W=sum_i r_i Ai, retaining each branch's original private-tip multiplicity. For every natural k with 1<=k and 2k<=N+2, integer-zero-extended coefficients satisfy W[k+1] C[k-1] <= W[k] C[k].
claims.scope: Guarded lower-half shifted-C comparison for the original-multiplicity-weighted tip-deletion deck over every profile; no actual eligibility premise. This is an auxiliary comparison and not MASS or the exact-ratio payment.
claims.reason: Independent exact replay found no failure through 18 branches (27,954 weighted comparisons), but gives no universal proof. The known unguarded counterexample is outside the retained rank guard.

claims.statement: For an ordinary arity-2,3,4 path-star, at an actual eligible p with x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, and 2p<=alpha, let x be the actual least strict descent of P. If C has positive interval support and is log-concave, Delta_x C<0, and W[p+1]C[p-1]<=W[p]C[p] for W=sum_i r_i Ai with original tip multiplicities, then some branch i has Delta_p Ai<0.
claims.scope: Conditional implication at the actual current p only. Requires positive W[p], C[p-1], C[p] to divide by; retains strict selectors, actual first descent, every eligibility guard, integer zero extension, and all original branch tip multiplicities. Does not prove the weighted LR premise or a payment statement.
claims.reason: The positive-denominator division and adjacent-ratio argument are valid at the stated scope: Delta_x C<0 gives C[x+1]/C[x]<1, log-concavity and p>=x+2 give C[p]/C[p-1]<=C[x+1]/C[x], hence Delta_p W<0. Since Delta_p W=sum_i r_i Delta_p Ai with each r_i>0, at least one branch slope is strictly negative.

limitations: Both universal guarded LR candidates remain open; finite coefficient scans do not establish universal truth.
The all-rank rank-77 witness is outside the lower-half guard and is not an eligible counterexample.
The conditional selector implication does not prove its weighted premise, selected MASS, exact-ratio payment, aggregate, or a formal theorem.
